ty.announce-note: The practice will be in touch
ty.h1: Thank you. The practice has your request
ty.lead: Someone from Legacy Dental Pasadena will call to confirm your appointment, usually the same working day. If you sent this outside office hours, expect the call the next morning.
ty.meta: 1213 N. Lake Ave #1, Pasadena, CA 91104 · Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM
ty.next-h2: Four things, and the first one is ours
ty.next-text: The consultation takes about an hour. Nothing is decided at it, and there is nothing to pay.
ty.step1-text: A member of the team rings to agree a time that works, and answers anything you want to ask before you come in.
ty.step2-text: Dr. Sunyoto examines your teeth and takes an iTero digital scan. There are no putty impressions, and the scan takes a few minutes.
ty.step3-text: The scan builds a preview of where your teeth would finish. You see it, and the plan behind it, before deciding anything.
ty.step4-title: You decide, or you do not
ty.step4-text: If you want to go ahead, a $100 refundable deposit reserves the $3,379 price while your aligners are made. If you would rather not, that is the end of it.
ty.provider-caption: Dr. Sean Sunyoto, DDS · Legacy Dental Pasadena
ty.provider-h2: Dr. Sean Sunyoto will be the one treating you
ty.provider-text: He plans every Invisalign case at the practice himself and reviews each set of aligners with the patient. Legacy Dental Pasadena is a 2026 Invisalign Diamond Provider, Align Technology's top tier.
ty.reviews-h2: Patients on the practice you have just booked with
ty.legal: Consultations are free and carry no obligation. Individual results vary.
